text.text_excerpt: My daughter told me about this place she was following on social media. My first response was to ask her why she hadn't told me about it sooner. Within a week we went for lunch. When we got there around 12:30 there was an UberEats person picking up an order. While we waited for our order, several other people came in to place orders. Good thing we came when we did! My daughter ordered wings. She got hot and lemon pepper. She said the hot wings were exactly what she wanted. She ate them and offered me some of the lemon pepper which is my favorite. They were awesome. I dropped her off at home and returned to work. A couple days later I fussed at her because I asked her if she was going to e...

Found out about this place from my friend's sister, apparently a lot of her school friends were raving about this. It is not in the best neighborhood, but I am all about hole in the wall places! I came here twice in a week, back to back. I was able to easily find street parking, but I noticed there was a large "Miracles Parking" in a fenced gravel lot when I left. On the first day, I ordered a bunch of things to try by myself. Their menu was huge, so I wanted to try everything! The kitchen was probably wondering if I was eating all of that by myself. I ordered the Seafood Baked Potato, Fried Pickles, Garlic Parmesan Wings, Lemon Pepper Wings, Steak Taco (Taco Tuesday option) with Honey Sr...

I enjoy this spot. However, it can take a while for your food to.come up do if you can call ahead and agree to pick up. This spot gets so busy around 12 with kunch irders it can get overwhelming. They offer a wide variety of all types of stuff. Wings, quesadillas, pasta,potatoes, nachos,chips,frozen cups,hamburgers, hotdogs,etc.. you are definitely bound to get something to your liking here. The juice ootions available is so good. A nice and heavy syrup juice i must say which my son enjoys! Very cool staff. Food is nice and fresh. I come here too much!
